name: Hybrid Distributed-Memory Parallel Volume Rendering (Childs et al.)
definition: A hybrid approach developed by Childs et al. that classifies cells as small or large depending on the number of samples per cell, serving as the basis for the algorithm described in this document.
summary: This algorithm balances load by classifying cells as small or large, using object-order sampling for small cells and image-order sampling for large cells to ensure scalability on unstructured grids.
